decisions.statement: Every map is measured against Tamriel rather than against its parent.
A map is measured the first time the map is shown.
A measurement taken for a map is kept for as long as the game runs.
The game's own map changing functions are wrapped rather than replaced.
A map outside Tamriel is measured against a root map of its own.
This library needs LibMapPing loaded first.
This library needs LibDebugLogger loaded first.
This library needs LibChatMessage loaded first.

definition: one map's coordinates carried onto Tamriel's and onto the world's
